reviews.text: We are very happy with the results of our pool renovation. We did not think the pool was going to survive, but Gus and his crew did an amazing job and now our pool looks like new again. The whole job took less than a week. He was always on time And very informative. He kept us up-to-date every step of the way. I would highly recommend him for your fiberglass pool restoration and repairs.

Gus and his crew were incredible.  They do amazing and efficient work. We had a 50 year old leaky concrete pool and it looks brand new.  The crew showed up early and worked so had during the day. They had this makeover/renovation done in 5 days.  They tested everything out and cleaned up the sandstone as much as they could.  I would and have highly recommended to several of my friends.

Gus and his crew were extremely nice and professional. They were “down to business” the day they arrived! I could not be happier with the professionalism, the hard work, the price, and what it means to our family to have a pool again! Fixing our pool helped in preventing our house from settling as it’s fairly close to the house. They fixed bulges, cracks, and totally refinished what is a 40 plus year old pool! This also means a great deal to us as we have a disabled daughter that now will be abl

DFW Fiberglass Pool Renovations did such an amazing job converting our antiquated vinyl liner pool into a more attractive, and easier to maintain, fiberglass pool. Their work also included fixing a light conduit leak, updating electrical connections, and texturing our existing patio with “Cool Deck.”
The owner Gus is involved in the entire process, and the whole crew is very hard working and professional. We are so pleased that we found them!  They were able to use our existing pool structure -

DFW Fiberglass Pool Renovations just finished renovating my pool & deck with new fiberglass gelcoat, concrete with cool deck, tile, & flagstone  coping. Gus & everyone working with him were so pleasant and professional. They were prompt, worked hard, & completed in a timely manner at a reasonable cost. Were considerate of property & gave attention to every detail. A fantastic job & beautiful completed pool!  I would highly recommend DFW Fiberglass Pool & Gus if any type of pool work is needed. Y

I cannot recommend this company enough.  Not only did they meet their quote on a complex job and stay on schedule, but they were one of the most professional contracting teams I have ever worked with.  Gus was on-sight daily, and his entire team (including Juan and Jonathan) made sure that every detail met the highest standards.  They not only handled my fiberglass pool, but installed new coping, new concrete around the pool, a pergola, stone structure/countertop with a grill and refrigerator, d

Great job, timely, and even monitored pool refill while I was out of state. My pool is now beautiful and we are already taking advantage of our new ladder and handrail.  Great work on resurfacing pool and getting my drain up to code.  Highly recommend.  Adding before and after photos.

our experience with this pool company was fantastic. they were attentive, communicative, and always kept us updated. their professionalism was outstanding. this pool has been completely transformed-- highly recommend!!

Gus and his crew were awesome to work with! My parents 45 yr old fiberglass pool was in awful shape and we actually thought about just removing it, but the DFW fiberglass crew made it look like new. It was a difficult job cutting through years of roots to repair the plumbing and fix the holes/bubble in the walls, but somehow they did it. Thank you so very much! 5 stars, highly recommend.

Gus and crew are true craftsman. They brought my pool back to life in a short amount of time. They even went out of their way to touch up a few minor issues outside of the major renovation work. Communication is top notch with this company and I cannot recommend them enough.

Gus and his team were on point with our pool gel coating! Knocked it out in 3 day! Gus was great in communicating with us during the process since we had not moved into the house yet and lived far away making it hard for us to be there. Highly recommend!

Gus and his team did an amazing job on renovating my pool. After multiple estimates and finding someone i could trust DFW Fiberglass pool was the only company with a reasonable price. I highly recommend Gus he’s very knowledgeable and explained every detail and questions need so I could understand the pool repairs. My pool has never looked this good! I can’t wait for the weather to clean up to use it just in time for the summer. I am very happy thank you Gus!
If I could give these guys 10 stars I would. Amazing job and very reasonable on price. They know their business and are the best. They were fast and got us up and going in a few days.

Picking a pool service was terrifying to my husband and me . We knew nothing about pools before we became an owner of one. DFW Fiberglass has changed that scenario. Gus (the owner) has really stood by his word😊DFW Fiberglass renovated our pool and we are happy to say we love it! The pool feels and looks new . There were some bumpy issues but Gus faced them with encouragement, wisdom, and professionalism. They are our pool service company as long as we own a pool. I recommend them 100%!!!!

Last summer Gus and his crew came to resurface my pool. However, the paint stated to peel and the fiberglass was rough. I called Gus again this summer and he took a little while to come fix it because he had a big project. They showed up almost at the end of summer and they not only resurfaced again, but they fixed a crack that my pool had due to the extreme heat this year . I really appreciate them coming to fix my pool once again. They know how important it was for me because the pool is my so

Gus and his team at DFW Fiberglass Pool Renovations are absolutely awesome. If you’re thinking about using them, get on it. Gus has been extremely helpful, open, and honest throughout this whole process, which we really appreciated because we’d been struggling to find someone we could trust. We had a plaster pool that needed to be redone and got several quotes last year. We never moved forward with any of them because we just didn’t feel comfortable with nor confident about any of the companies

My wife and I could not be happier with the service that was provided by this company.! After setting a few appointments it was not a hard decision at all to go with Gus and his crew, I needed my pool to be resurfaced and gel coated with the cold season here I decided it was a good way to end the year and have our pool ready for the summer time. Gus and his crew were very clean workers very good communication skill and they 100% follow through with their 100% customer satisfaction guarantee.! I

Gus and his crew are hands down our favorite contractors that help us keep things together with our pool. He sends someone out as soon as possible whenever we have called, and it truly makes us feel prioritized. He stays in communication throughout the entire process so other than the reasons why we have reached out, nothing comes as a surprise. He understands the issues that can arise unexpectedly and let us know where and how we can save dollars without compromising our system or experience. H

Highly recommend DFW Fiberglass Pool Renovations! Gus was friendly, honest and quick to respond to any of my questions and concerns. If you want someone who will provide great service, great communication and are great at what they do then Gus and his team are the perfect people to work with.

Gus and his crew were amazing from start to finish! Not only was the quality of work done to the highest of standards, but it was done in a timely manner. He was easy to communicate with and he made sure to keep me up to date throughout the whole process. I cannot recommend Gus and his crew enough!
